Exercise: PEC DECK MACHINE FLY, classic bent-elbow forearm-pad machine, mid-contraction. Full graphite machine with upright back pad/seat, overhead pivoting paired lever arms connected to two vertical forearm pads. Mannequin sits upright supported against backrest, feet flat. Upper arms forward and slightly out to sides at chest/shoulder height; elbows bent approximately 90 degrees, FOREARMS VERTICAL pressing against the inner surfaces of pads; closed grips on short handles above pads. Pads move inward in an arc toward each other, not a forward chest press. Show coherent machine pivots and full foot-supported frame. Front three-quarter camera makes both elbows/forearms, pad contacts, seated support visible. Highlight pectoralis major coral only; arms grey.

review.notes: Both forearms contact vertical pads with elbows bent; seated back support and planted feet; coherent overhead pivots and chest-only overlay. Lever arms remain relatively open; internal resistance linkage schematic. Top frame margin narrow but uncropped.
